title: Selective two-electron and four-electron oxygen reduction reactions using Co-based electrocatalysts
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2025, 54,5248-5291
DOI: 10.1039/D4CS01199F, Review Article
Zuozhong Liang, Haitao Lei, Haoquan Zheng, Hong-Yan Wang, Wei Zhang, Rui Cao
Recent progress made in Co-based electrocatalysts for selective four-electron (4e−) and two-electron (2e−) electrocatalytic oxygen reduction reactions is reviewed.
